# Hooks

Hooks are ordered callbacks. Use hooks for extension and metrics collectors for observation.

```ts
const rpc = new RpcClient('https://rpc.example.org', {
  hooks: {
    beforeRequest: (request) => request,
    onError: (error, context) => {
      // observe or report structured errors
    }
  }
})
```

Hooks receive generic data only. Domain-specific behavior belongs in packages that use this core.
